new_value: HubSpot Revenue Hub (formerly Commerce Hub) now runs full quote-to-cash including CPQ, contracts and billing on its CRM, live since June 16, 2026, with a usage pricing model due September 2026.
headline: HubSpot expands into quote-to-cash with Revenue Hub, taking on Salesforce Revenue Cloud and CPQ
so_what: Reps can no longer paint HubSpot as payments-only in a quote-to-cash deal. Concede that HubSpot now covers quoting through billing in one CRM, then win on Revenue Cloud CPQ depth: complex configurable pricing, multi-entity billing and enterprise governance that HubSpot's new stack does not yet match, plus the fact HubSpot's own usage pricing is not even set until September.

new_value: HubSpot Agent Hub and Agent Builder are in public beta: a single console to monitor every agent, plus natural-language custom agent building on CRM data with access controls and run limits.
headline: HubSpot ships Agent Hub and Agent Builder in public beta, taking Breeze into custom agents and centralized management
so_what: Stop telling mid-market and enterprise buyers that HubSpot only has prebuilt agents with no way to build or centrally manage custom ones. That line is now wrong and a sharp buyer will catch it. Anchor the Agentforce advantage on the depth this beta still lacks: the trust layer on every transaction, trusted agent identity and LLM governance through Agent Fabric, plus back-office agents via Agentforce Operations.

new_value: HubSpot reversed its July 1 opt-out data-sharing terms on July 5 after customer backlash, with its product chief admitting "We made a mistake" and pledging fully opt-in enrichment going forward.
headline: HubSpot retreats on opt-out data-sharing after customer revolt
so_what: When HubSpot pitches its enrichment and prospecting data as a reason to buy, or claims to be the permission-first CRM, a Salesforce rep can put this on the table: HubSpot tried to fold customers' own contact data into a shared pool by default and only backed off under public pressure. Use it to raise the data-ownership question in trust-sensitive deals and point to Salesforce's contractual data isolation.
